domains.title: Machine learning and local language models
domains.concept: Models that run where the user is: local and miniature language models, training, and machine-learning reference code.

domains.title: Autonomous agents, AGI and retrieval
domains.concept: From aGLM to mindX: autonomous general learning machines, retrieval augmented generation, agent orchestration and the agent marketplace.

domains.title: Interfaces, web3D and the expressive web
domains.concept: How intelligence and chains are seen and touched: UI/UX extensions, faces, 3D engines and client-side JavaScript.

domains.title: DeltaVerse and DAO governance
domains.concept: The DeltaVerse metaDAO and the Decentralized Autonomous Intelligent Organization: inception contracts, governance patterns and experiments.

domains.title: Chains, layers and interoperability
domains.concept: Building and joining blockchains: the THRUST/TNT chains, layer 3 deployment kits, bridges and per-chain exploration.

domains.title: Smart contracts and EVM tooling
domains.concept: Contract programming and the tools around the Ethereum Virtual Machine, including machine intelligence applied to Solidity.

domains.title: DeFi, stable value and trading
domains.concept: Value and its movement: flash loans, pegged assets, DAI, limit orders, DEX middleware, trading research and the LUV and BANKON tokens.

domains.title: NFTs and digital assets
domains.concept: Ownership of digital things: NFT creation, royalties, marketplaces, programmable keys and Bitcoin ordinals.

domains.title: Wallets, identity and sovereignty
domains.concept: Keys are identity: wallets, account abstraction, identity management, vaults, MetaMask extensions, private networking and the cypherpunk standard.

domains.title: Storage and the decentralized web
domains.concept: Permanence and distribution: IPFS, decentralized front ends and storage.

domains.title: Communication
domains.concept: Token, talk and transaction: wallet-to-wallet messaging and blockchain communication systems.

domains.title: Oracles, theory and the living world
domains.concept: The questions behind the work: the Pythia oracle, prediction, a grand unified theory, the mind as a chain, and water as life.

This repository is an HTML5 JavaScript and CSS3 example using live real-time data stream from a server.  Where PubNub fits in is in the mediation and brokering of the message stream in real-time to millions of people.
